section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1978
title: 26 Uttar Pradesh (44·8%), Meghalaya (32·5%), Assam (12·8%), Madhya Pradesh (12·4%), Karnataka (9·7%), Haryana (3·1%) and Punjab (2·3%). The States which registered a decline were Himacha Pradesh (59·0%), Tripura (26·9%), Orissa (25·8%), West Bengal (19·0%), Andhra Pradesh (8·5%), Maharashtra (6·2%), Tamil Nadu (5·7%) and Kerala (2·9%). The incidence of suicides for the Union Territories as a whole recorded a decline of 7·5 percent in 1978 over 1977. Out of 9 U. Ts., only 2 U. Ts., viz. Arunachal Pradesh and Andaman & Nicobar Islands recorded an increase of 120·00 percent and 18·8 percent respectively. The U. Ts. to register a decline during the same period were Mizoram (63·6%), D. & N. Haveli (44·0%), Delhi (16·3%), Chandigarh (5·0%), Goa, Daman & Diu (4·1%) and Pondicherry (2·1%), while no case was registered in Lakshadweep.
